title: Positive: one-time codes, reset tokens and passwords are handled to a high standard
expected: Secrets hashed, compared in constant time, attempt-limited and single-use.
actual: OTPs: 6 digits from crypto.randomBytes, stored as SHA-256 with an app salt, timingSafeEqual, attempt limit counted in Postgres (holds without Redis), invalidated after too many tries. Reset tokens: stored as SHA-256, expiring, single-use, and a reset revokes all sessions. Passwords: bcrypt cost 12; login runs a dummy bcrypt compare for unknown emails to avoid timing-based enumeration.
